contexts.text: In the Original Language it is a word which means both a vegetable and green... green, relatively to the pleasures of intellectual things or of the spiritual affections.
There was seen... another boy in a green garment, SE 3378.
A green appearance in the middle of a rainbow, seen.

There was not any green thing left () = that all the sensitive of truth was obliterated... Green = what is scientific and sensuous; here, what is sensitive of truth... The reason a green thing = what is sensitive of truth, is that by herb, grass, the leaf of a tree, are signified truths; from this, the green of them = what is sensitive of truth.
A green ear () = the good of truth.
Witches who when clothed appeared in green.
Under Grass, see this reference. AR 401. AR 426. AE 507.
Green = what is sensitive.
The Divine sphere... in the Natural Kingdom appears flashing green like an emerald.
That by green is signified what is living or alive. Illustrated.
The Hell where such are appears from afar like a fiery lake with a green flame as of sulphur.
The pupil of the eye as it were flashed in a green plain, which was from the light of phantasy. CL 5M 2.
The inmost flowers were of a shining green.
Is not the eyesight... quickened by a colour which inwardly takes something from black, such as green?
The colour green is not so much esteemed, except in so far as it partakes of blue.
He dwelt in a chamber... green in colour.
Therefore he loves urine, and also green.

Hereditary evils... in infants and children, appear... such as can be attempered with goods; as the colours black, green, blue, with the light... It is otherwise if evils are added by actual sin... The love of earthly things (in a child born of such parents) is as it were green...
In this manner to conceal things... and not to deal sincerely... likened to the colour green...
There appeared many green grassy things.
A great serpent almost green in colour...
He saw the leaves, not green...
The colour of (an emerald) is green; and green = truth obscured.
Every green tree () = all falsity which occurs.
Green () = living from truths.

That by green is signified what is alive, may be evident... because a plant, when it... as it were lives, is green; but when it as it were dies, the greenness perishes; and therefore by green is signified what is living or alive. Illustrated.
A green thing = what is scientific alive.
Green, and beautiful in form () = the truth of this good, from which comes intelligence.
Fat and green () = in the goods and truths of doctrine.
